name: logo-cloud
title: Logo cloud
description: A row of customer or integrator wordmarks under a short caption, separated by hairlines.

standards.purpose: Borrow trust from real integrators or customers at a glance.
useWhen: Named customers or integrators agreed to be listed.
doNotUseWhen: There are no real names to show — never invent logos.

rules.check: Every wordmark names a real customer or integrator; no invented companies.
